name: Late-onset scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy with hyaline bodies
aliases: Scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy type with hyaline bodies
Late-onset scapuloperoneal myopathy with hyaline inclusions

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed diagnostic criteria for late-onset scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy with hyaline bodies

criteria.description: Progressive muscle weakness predominantly affecting scapular and peroneal muscles with late onset
Presence of hyaline bodies on muscle biopsy histopathology
Electromyographic evidence of myopathic changes in affected muscles
Identification of pathogenic variants in associated genes (if known)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical pattern plus muscle biopsy demonstrating hyaline bodies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic etiology is not fully elucidated; diagnosis relies heavily on clinical and histopathological findings.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Scapular winging due to periscapular muscle weakness
searchTerms: shoulder blade sticks out due to muscle weakness
winged scapula from weak shoulder muscles
scapular winging caused by muscle weakness

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal lower limb weakness predominantly affecting peroneal muscles
searchTerms: weakness in lower leg muscles controlling foot
peroneal muscle weakness in distal legs

pathognomonic.symptomName: Muscle biopsy showing hyaline bodies within muscle fibers

searchTerms: mild wasting of shoulder blade muscles
slight muscle loss around shoulder blades
difficulty breathing due to muscle weakness

laboratory: Mild to moderate elevation of serum creatine kinase
imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective fatty replacement of scapular and peroneal muscles
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes associated with scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophies (gene not fully established)
other: Muscle biopsy demonstrating hyaline bodies on histopathology

distinguishingFeatures: Predominant proximal muscle weakness without characteristic hyaline bodies
Facial and shoulder girdle weakness with typical genetic deletion
Absence of hyaline bodies on muscle biopsy

redFlags: Marked dysphagia with risk of aspiration
references: Orphanet: Late-onset scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy with hyaline bodies, ORPHA:431263
